38c23ad8f3498571.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Field Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Field Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB. 

Such transformations are very time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Field Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI  technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Forward Deployed AI Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernization projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization  projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bangalore for our hybrid working model.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients. 
  • Proficiency in Python and Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages.
  • Expert level knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations.
  • Deep experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases.
  • Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable.
  • Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges.
  • Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems.
  • Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings. 
  • Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus.
  • And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations:

  • Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption.
  • Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organization.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap.
  • Personally execute well-defined, outcome-focused projects, POC, MVP and everything in between. POCs include developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations.
  • Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols.
  • Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams.
  • Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers.
  • Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month and to travel to Australia two weeks per year to collaborate with the Product development team

Success Measures:

The Forward Deployed AI Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

  • Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products.
  • Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering.
  • Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences.
  • Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field.
  • Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers.
  • Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

389ab20c62d19fe7.description: ## **About Juniper Square** Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! *Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* **About your role** As a Senior Engineer - Application and Platform Security on our Platform Engineering team, You’ll find and fix vulnerabilities across our applications and cloud infrastructure. Then you’ll build the guardrails, automation, and secure defaults that keep them from coming back. The role spans application code, build and deployment systems, cloud infrastructure, and our AI-powered features. It’s hands-on: you’ll write production-quality code, ship tools engineers want to use, and use AI agents to multiply your own output. **What you will do:** *Application and product security (your focus)* - Lead security design reviews and threat models for new product features, with depth in authentication, authorization, data isolation, and high-risk financial workflows. - Perform manual code review and security testing of web applications and APIs. Focus on the authorization and business logic flaws that scanners miss, and drive fixes through to verification. - Design secure-by-default libraries, framework-level controls, and custom static analysis rules that eliminate whole classes of vulnerabilities. - Triage application findings from automated and manual testing and external assessments. Group them by root cause and write remediation guidance engineers can act on. - Threat-model and test AI-powered product features against risks like prompt injection, unsafe tool use, data leakage, and excessive agency. Define secure patterns other teams can reuse. *Shared across the team* - Share design review and triage responsibilities across the team. - Support our external penetration testing program, from scoping through retest. - Partner with teammates on build pipeline and supply-chain security, especially dependency risk in application code. - Participate in incident response for application security events. - Build security automation and agents that cut review and triage time. **Qualifications** - Experience: 5+ years in application or product security, or in software engineering with a strong security focus. - Code review: Deep experience finding vulnerabilities through manual review. You find authorization and business logic flaws by reading code, not only by running a scanner. - Programming: Strong Python, plus working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, enough to review front-end code for client-side issues. You write production-quality code, not just scripts. - Identity: In-depth knowledge of OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, MFA, session management, and access control models, with hands-on experience implementing them securely. - Threat modeling: Experience leading threat modeling sessions with engineering teams and turning the output into concrete requirements. - Security tooling: Experience running and tuning SAST, SCA, and DAST, including writing custom rules. - Platform awareness: Working knowledge of cloud, container, and CI/CD security, enough to reason about how application design interacts with infrastructure. - AI security: A working understanding of LLM application risks and the drive to go deep. - Collaboration: Clear writing and a track record of influencing engineering teams without becoming a bottleneck. **Nice to have** - An offensive web security background, such as bug bounty, web application CVEs, or CTFs. Certifications like OSWE or BSCP are a plus, not a requirement. - Experience building developer-facing security tooling or libraries. - Experience building or running a security champions program. - Familiarity with OWASP ASVS or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

38d2a33a9bb48fab.description: 📍 Location: Flexible (Remote or Based in India) 👥 Company Size: 10+ (Growing Tech Team) 📈 Compensation: Equity-Based Partnership + salary 📅 Vesting Schedule: 4 years with a 1-year cliff About DharmikVibes DharmikVibes is India's leading spiritual tech platform, offering a phygital experience that connects users with religious and spiritual services across temples, pilgrimage sites, astrology, poojas, and e-commerce. Our platform integrates AI-driven personalized spiritual journeys, temple bookings, astrological consultations, and pilgrimage packages for both domestic and NRI devotees. With a strong tech foundation in AI, data analytics, and scalable cloud infrastructure, DharmikVibes is poised to redefine the $40B+ Indian spiritual and religious services industry. We are now seeking a visionary Senior Tech Leader to lead our next phase of technological innovation and shape the future of spiritual experiences with cutting-edge AI, blockchain, and personalization technologies. Role Overview You will lead the technology strategy, architecture, and product development while playing a key role in shaping DharmikVibes' future. You will drive innovation in AI-powered recommendations, e-commerce, payment systems, and pilgrimage travel solutions. Additionally, you will be an equity partner, contributing to both technology leadership and strategic decision-making. Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Strategy & Innovation Define and execute DharmikVibes' technology roadmap, ensuring scalability, security, and AI-driven personalization. Leverage AI, data analytics, and cloud computing to enhance astrology consultations, pooja bookings, and travel experiences. Integrate blockchain-powered digital payments, NFTs for religious artifacts, and secure user transactions. Product & Platform Development Oversee the end-to-end development of web and mobile platforms using Flutter, and Python/Django. Enhance AI-driven personalization for user recommendations in pilgrimage packages, astrology, and e-commerce. Optimize secure payment gateways, temple donation systems, and astrology consultation APIs. Leadership & Team Building Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing tech team of engineers, data scientists, and AI specialists. Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and rapid iteration. Collaborate with product, marketing, and business teams to align technology with user experience and growth goals. Strategic Contributions Participate in high-level strategic decision-making alongside founders and investors. Represent DharmikVibes at industry conferences, spiritual forums, and technology summits. Qualifications & SkillsEssential: ✅ 7+ years of experience in technology leadership (VP of Engineering, or Tech Lead). ✅ Expertise in AI, cloud computing, web & mobile development (Python, Djang, Flutter, AWS). ✅ Proven ability to scale platforms from MVP to millions of users. ✅ Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation in spirituality and technology. ✅ Strong leadership, collaboration, and decision-making skills. ✅ Willingness to invest financially and commit to long-term growth. Preferred: ✔ Experience in travel, fintech, or e-commerce platforms. ✔ Knowledge of astrology, pilgrimage logistics, or temple management solutions. ✔ A network of technology partners, investors, or clients in the spiritual & travel industry. **Why Join DharmikVibes? ** 🌏 Impact: Shape the future of spiritual tech in India's $40B+ religious services market. 📈 High Growth: Lead an innovative AI-powered spiritual ecosystem with global expansion potential. 🤝 Equity & Partnership: Be a founding technology leader in a startup backed by a strong tech team & advisors. 🕉 Spiritual Innovation: Leverage AI, blockchain, and big data to create personalized spiritual experiences. 💡 If you are a visionary tech leader passionate about innovation and spirituality, apply now to be part of this transformative journey! 🚀🙏
